message: Hey Jane, just checking in. How's your mom feeling today? Heard she was under the weather before I left.
Morning Jane! Are we still on for the study group this Thursday?
Happy Birthday, Jane! Hope you're having a blast! 🎉
Hey, saw a book and thought of you. It's called 'The Art of Focus'. You should check it out!
Landed safely. The conference starts tomorrow. Will keep you posted.
Don't wait up for me, I'll be working late at the lab tonight. Love you.
Jane, can you send me the notes from today's biochem lecture?
Reminder: Project proposals are due next Monday. Make sure to submit before the deadline.
Just a heads-up, I'll be unreachable for most of tomorrow. In meetings all day.
Happy Valentine's Day, sweetheart! Dad and I are so proud of you.
